content.title: Fran McCaffery, Penn earn NCAA bid in first year after Iowa dismissal
content.text: IOWA MEN'S BASKETBALLFormer Hawkeye coach Fran McCaffery gets to March Madness with PennHawk Central staff reportDes Moines RegisterMarch 15, 2026Updated March 16, 2026, 7:35 a.m. CTKeep WatchingFormer Iowa basketball coach Fran McCaffery has led the University of Pennsylvania to the NCAA Tournament in his first year with the Quakers.Penn (18-11) beat Yale 88-84 in overtime on Sunday, March 15 in the championship game of the Ivy League Tournament to punch its ticket to March Madness.TJ Power had 44 points and 14 rebounds for Penn in the title game. He hit a 3-pointer with 1 second left to send the game to overtime.Iowa parted ways with McCaffery after the 2024-25 season as the program regressed and fan apathy increased. Ben McCollum was hired as McCaffery's replacement.Survivor Pool: NCAA Tournament Survivor Pool Sweepstakes | USA TODAY Sports Bracket Challenge: Bracket Challenge Sweepstakes | USA TODAY Sports McCaffery, a Philadelphia native, was named coach at his alma mater shortly after he left the Hawkeyes. He has taken five schools to the NCAA Tournament.Iowa also is likely headed to the NCAA Tournament. The Hawkeyes are 21-12 and projected as a 9 or 10 seed.
